decisions.explanation: Common preconditions require identification of the actual removable-cell or sealed variant before any power action, and the operative cases branch to the supported procedure.
The common preconditions explicitly state that supplied host and MRM24 facts do not establish DUT power construction or compatibility.
Unsupported functions are assigned N/A with a basis, while unresolved applicability is held pending and cannot receive a pass/fail disposition.
The case measures physical-motion onset to first pointer displacement using synchronized video or equivalent instrumentation and records instrument resolution.
Known targets and fixed screen conditions establish coordinates, while successful target hits and total attempts are retained with positional deviation.
Controlled starting screens are restored between trials, with Back evaluated for one-level return and Exit for leaving the active context.
The case records BT, language, account, consent, network and service conditions, repeats the measurements, retains each observation and calculates the mean.
Bluetooth is demonstrated through pointer or smart control while the competing IR route is blocked; ordinary basic-key responses are not used to inherit the pointer route.
The case applies rapid wheel input, releases it, and observes continued motion, deceleration and the final stopped position.
The selected external endpoint is observed audibly as well as through OSD state, and the acceptance text rejects OSD-only proof.
Every case has a recognized P0 or P1 priority, with pairing, fallback and primary pointer-control work ranked P0 ahead of lower-consequence P1 cases.
Synchronized timestamps separately capture the OK trigger, first pairing indication, registration confirmation and first successful control.
The case keeps user-visible completion, the protocol timeout and the post-deregistration OK window as separately scoped events and clocks.
Repeat attempts begin from a cleared binding and retain successes, total attempts, failures, timeouts and retry outcomes.
Bluetooth unavailability must be verified through connection state or a pointer check before fallback attribution.
The same documented basic command is compared with IR unobstructed and blocked while Bluetooth remains unavailable.
The case restores IR and Bluetooth, repeats basic-button and pointer checks, and limits the IR conclusion to the verified basic keys.
A BT-addressed pointer or smart command is sent while target and non-target TVs are observed concurrently.
BT-addressed observations are separated from basic IR trials, and shared IR responses are explicitly excluded from BT-misbinding classification.
The procedure records a no-interference baseline, an interference phase and a restoration repeat with phase-specific counts and events.
Removable cells are handled only on the confirmed removable-cell variant; sealed variants use an approved external procedure or remain pending and are never opened.
Retained binding and pointer resumption are checked before pressing OK, with auto-reconnect and manual re-pair routes recorded separately.
The case records observed route and elapsed time while explicitly refusing to infer universal persistence or a recovery deadline from power restoration.
hide-endpoint independently satisfied by the Golden pointer timing cases.
wake-endpoint independently satisfied by the Golden pointer timing cases.
Pointer visibility is explicitly separated from remote current or power sleep, and the acceptance criteria prohibit merging their distinct timers.
Screen coordinates are recorded before disappearance and compared with the coordinates restored after a controlled motion-only wake.
Known scrollable and wheel-supported contexts are selected, starting position is held or restored, and unsupported seeking is classified N/A.
Short and separately timed long presses are compared after resetting to the same recorded starting screen.
The case selects a different listed channel through the channel list or guide and confirms the actual resulting programme.
Microphone-button actuation to waveform or visible voice UI is measured as its own interval.
Microphone LED-on to the actual commanded action is measured separately from the UI-wake interval.
Supported local and network-dependent commands are classified into separate series, with source limits applied only to their corresponding endpoints and conditions.
The network/service state is recorded and an offline trial exercises the network-dependent command path and records the unavailable-cloud outcome.
Each attempted command retains the spoken reference, recognized text or intent, executed action, correctness and failed or timed-out attempts.
Recognition correctness and action correctness are separately defined over all attempted commands, including failures.
WER uses reference words and edit counts, and the case explicitly states that it is not the command success rate.
Quiet and noise trials use the same corpus, speaking geometry, language, network state, speaker level and trial count.
A calibrated sound-level meter measures dB/SPL at the microphone position; TV volume percentage is explicitly rejected as a substitute.
The case separately calculates condition success rates, percentage-point drop and relative loss, with relative loss declared undefined for a zero quiet baseline.
The original remote and target are identified, and the selected unlearned DUT key is shown not to control the target before learning.
CEC and competing routes are disabled for learning, after which the learned command is compared with the IR path open and blocked.
The stored mapping is retested after an approved variant-specific power cycle, with device identity and overwritten mappings recorded.
Bluetooth is first made unavailable, then the same basic command is compared with direct IR line of sight, opaque obstruction and restored line of sight.
Distance trials hold angle fixed, angle trials hold distance fixed, and per-point attempts, outcomes and actual geometry are retained.
Both BT and IR cases treat nominal ranges and selected angles as scoped measurements and explicitly reject universal range or all-angle guarantees.
At marked multiple distances, the same fixed command population is attempted and pointer or smart-control successes, latency, disconnects and reconnection are recorded.
With Bluetooth unable to carry the command, multiple chosen distances use the same basic IR command and repetition count with successes, attempts and latency retained.
The case inventories physical service labels and confirms region, installation, entitlement and network availability before evaluation.
Installed services and permitted uninstalled or unavailable services are exercised from the same initial screen, with the initial state restored.
Launch timing ends at the app-ready screen rather than playback completion, and any timing limit requires confirmed source and applicability.
Volume is driven through minimum and maximum boundaries, with the expected result requiring that the limits do not wrap.
Mute, unmute and volume changes are observed audibly at the selected internal or supported external endpoint, including endpoint restoration behavior.
HDMI-CEC is exercised separately with IR blocked, and successful external-target control is classified specifically as the CEC route.
No adopted case substitutes an unsafe power source or opens a sealed battery; the cases explicitly prohibit sealed-pack disassembly.
Timing and range values are consistently scoped by endpoint, source and applicability, with nominal or disputed values withheld from universal guarantees.
The workbook specifies proposed observations and recording procedures but does not present fabricated execution results.
The adopted experiments isolate Bluetooth, IR and HDMI-CEC and avoid attributing one route's response to another protocol.
Feature availability is conditioned on hardware, firmware, region, installation, entitlement and documented applicability rather than asserted universally.
Host Bluetooth and accessory facts are explicitly identified as insufficient to establish DUT construction or compatibility.
The voice action interval correctly begins at microphone LED-on, while microphone-button actuation is reserved for the separate visible-UI interval.
Recognition and action execution are separately recorded and calculated, so joint execution is not substituted for recognition accuracy.
Retention evidence uses an approved power cycle of the applicable learning-memory remote variant and does not rely on a charger or unrelated-device reset.
Pointer hiding and functional wake are explicitly separated from electrical or current-based remote power sleep, with no proxy claim adopted.
